result.result:
Perfect! The installation is complete:

- **pre-commit 4.7.0** is installed at `/opt/enforce/tool-installs/pre-commit/bin/pre-commit`
- With `/opt/enforce/tool-installs/bin` on the PATH (which we configured in the global settings earlier), `pre-commit --version` returns `pre-commit 4.7.0`
- This PATH configuration is in `/root/.claude/settings.json` under `env.PATH`, so both root and the agent user will have access to pre-commit when running Claude Code sessions
- The symlink/wrapper at `/opt/enforce/tool-installs/bin/pre-commit` points to the executable

Both R5 and R6 (the encoding and AI-Assisted comment rules) can now use pre-commit hooks for enforcement. Ready for the next node.
